messages:
maya_cs: Heads up  LatticeGrid renewal hits in 19 days. Procurement pushed on the +9% list and wants two concessions: (1) tiered pricing so monthly seats above 500 drop to a lower band, and (2) split PO: US entity pays 60% now, EU entity pays 40% after fiscal close. They asked if we can accept split PO + one amendment guaranteeing no mid-term price increases.
pete_ae: That split PO is unusual but doable if Billing + Legal sign off. Tiered pricing could be handled as a schedule in the amendment. Can RevOps/Finance confirm revenue recognition implications?
revops: Policy note: split-entity POs accepted only if both POs include vendor code and line items mapping; revenue recognized per delivery to each legal entity. We can permit a price schedule in the amendment but require explicit seat bands and effective dates. CC fallback allowed for up to one invoice cycle per entity if vendor code creation lags. Need exec-level email from the customer confirming split payment plan.
anas_billing: For AP mapping we need two separate POs (one per billing entity) with vendor codes. Preferred format (examples):
```
PO (US): LG-US-2026-9001
Vendor code: 77123-RW
Line: 60% of seats (300 seats) - Redwood Inference
Billing entity: Redwood Inc.

PO (EU): LG-EU-2026-9002
Vendor code: 77124-RW
Line: 40% of seats (200 seats) - Redwood EU Services Ltd.
Billing entity: Redwood EU Services Ltd.
```
Also need currency preference per PO to avoid FX mismatches. If EU PO is in EUR, include VAT ID.
claire_legal: If we add tiered pricing and split POs we should draft a short amendment containing: (a) a price schedule table with seat bands and per-seat rates; (b) clause that "no list increases" apply during the 12-month amendment period; (c) split-PO acceptance flow and invoicing responsibilities; and (d) payment milestone language so finance can map revenue. I can draft today but need the exact seat bands and whether the lower band is retroactive to day 1.
maya_cs: Customer says the lower band should apply only to seats above the 500 threshold, effective on signature. They want the EU split invoiced at EUR and US invoiced at USD. They also asked if we can include 8 hours of onboarding credit tied to the EU portion.
pete_ae: I'll ask procurement to produce both POs today and request a short exec-confirmation email. If Legal drafts amendment, can we send DocuSign immediately?
claire_legal: Yes I can draft an amendment with a pricing table. Will include currency/VAT language and an onboarding-credit clause (credit applied to EU invoice as a negative line item). ETA ~4h.
docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope prepared (draft): env-LG-900x. Link: https://docusign.example/envelope/env-LG-900x
maya_cs: Quick risk note: LatticeGrid's vendor onboarding for EU subsidiary often takes 12-18 days to create vendor code. If EU vendor code delays >10 days we should consider CC fallback for EU invoice. @revops is CC fallback okay?
revops: CC fallback allowed for one invoice cycle per entity with exec email attached and clear collection milestones. Finance will not recognize committed ARR until both POs or signed amendment are received per policy. If the EU PO arrives after 45 days, we'll need to reassess credit treatment.
oliver_finance: Finance confirm: we can accept split-entity POs and different currencies. For EUR invoicing we need their VAT ID and remittance bank details. If EU withholdings apply, we need a gross-up clause or the customer's WHT certificate. Also approve CC fallback for one cycle only; attach exec confirmation and expected PO ETA.
pete_ae: Got it  I'll chase procurement for both POs and request VAT ID + bank details. Maya, can you secure exec confirmation and ask for the onboarding timing?
maya_cs: On it. I'll collect exec email tonight and paste both PO drafts here when received. Will also upload the DocuSign envelope when Claire finishes the amendment. Thanks all. :pray:
